lastCompletedStory.title: cam stop / cam resume target the supervisor

nextStoryContext: ResumeMode now has 'live-supervisor' (was 'respawn' for PID-alive case) and 'orphaned-worker' (pane alive but no supervisor). isWorkerPaneAlive uses tmux list-panes -a -F #{pane_id} on the cam socket. StopReport has supervisorKilled (SIGTERM sent to pid from state file) and workerPaneKilled (respawn-pane -k to .cam-worker-pane pane). Any future story that checks for resume mode 'respawn' should note that 'live-supervisor' is the new name for the PID-alive branch.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-009 uses only Node.js process.kill (built-in) and the existing tmux socket pattern. No new npm packages introduced.
